Priya: I want to ask about assistance programs. Do you use SNAP?
Grace: I rely on SNAP every month, but renewing my SNAP paperwork takes hours on hold with the benefits office.
Priya: What is the hardest part of the paperwork?
Grace: The SNAP renewal paperwork asks for documents I already submitted, and every missing document delays my benefits by weeks.
Priya: How long did your last benefits renewal take?
Grace: My last benefits renewal took six weeks, and during those six weeks of paperwork delays I used the food pantry twice.
Priya: Do you ever lose benefits over paperwork?
Grace: I lost SNAP twice over paperwork errors the office itself made, and appealing the benefits denial took months.
Priya: Is the online benefits portal helpful?
Grace: The online benefits portal crashes every time I upload documents, so I end up mailing paperwork and hoping.
Priya: How do the WIC or school meal programs compare?
Grace: WIC paperwork is just as bad as SNAP paperwork, and the school meal form asked for the same income documents again.
Priya: What would fix the paperwork burden for you?
Grace: A case worker who can see my file would fix it; the benefits system loses my paperwork every single renewal cycle.
Priya: Any last thought on the assistance programs?
Grace: The assistance programs help when they work, but the paperwork around benefits feels like a second unpaid job.
